equations_and_steps.label: eq:residual-angle-derivative
equations_and_steps.scope: The tangential derivative of the loss in one direction equals the mass times the great-circle derivative of the probe of the residual; the same declaration as eq:residual-loss-pairing-main.

equations_and_steps.label: eq:directional-hessian-notation
equations_and_steps.scope: Notation: directional derivatives of the loss along the displacement paths; the Lean proof differentiates the loss along polarPath, the mass--direction path of a common linear displacement of all generators.

equations_and_steps.label: eq:jumper_function
equations_and_steps.scope: Definition of the jumper function psi(t) = sin t - t cos t.

equations_and_steps.label: eq:jumper_derivative
equations_and_steps.scope: Exact: psi has derivative chi(t) = t sin t.

equations_and_steps.label: eq:reciprocity_green
equations_and_steps.scope: Green reciprocity of the two clamped branches, proved through conservation of the adjoint boundary form.

equations_and_steps.label: eq:green-sign-claims
equations_and_steps.scope: Exact: interior positivity of the clamped Green function and both strict endpoint curvatures, for every gap length up to a full period.

equations_and_steps.label: eq:Mzero_positive
equations_and_steps.scope: Exact: the source-to-left-end curvature numerator M_0 is strictly positive.

equations_and_steps.label: eq:data-teacher-bound
equations_and_steps.scope: Exact: at a scaling-stationary point the sample student moment is at most the teacher moment, which is at most R_2 S^2/4.

equations_and_steps.label: stp:reductions
equations_and_steps.scope: Reduction: a local minimum on the unit-direction parameter space is a local minimum along every polar displacement path, which is how the Lean proof uses the generator coordinates; merging and freezing are handled inside the confinement assembly.

equations_and_steps.label: stp:zn_hessian_kernel
equations_and_steps.scope: The normal second derivative of the centered loss vanishes at a local minimum whose teacher lies in the range of the isometry J (the teacher span); this is the conclusion of the trace identity eq:global-trace.

equations_and_steps.label: stp:conclusion
equations_and_steps.scope: The finite mixed energy of eq:mixed-term-formula vanishes at the centered local minimum; its positivity when some normal component is non-zero gives the confinement.

equations_and_steps.label: stp:comments_plain_relu
equations_and_steps.scope: The plain-ReLU analogue of the null normal curvature, with the first-moment correction of eq:plain-correction-trace.

equations_and_steps.label: stp:comments_plain_relu
equations_and_steps.scope: The plain-ReLU positivity: Step 8.3 rerun for the ReLU feature, without any separation of the students.

equations_and_steps.label: eq:loss-quadratic-regrouped
equations_and_steps.scope: The regrouping of eq:loss-quadratic by the residual; the same declaration as eq:residual-loss.

equations_and_steps.label: eq:ring-operator
equations_and_steps.scope: Exact: for a six times continuously differentiable tangential displacement, the derivative of the beam operator applied to its derivative is Love's sixth-order operator; Love's equation (12) itself is a cited physical model.

equations_and_steps.label: eq:angular-kernel-d2+1
equations_and_steps.scope: Specialized: the centered kernel q=C, as the derivative of Phi_C' = -sin * arcsin(cos) at every angle; the plain case is Plain.plainKernel_second_derivative.

equations_and_steps.label: eq:green-decomposition
equations_and_steps.scope: Specialized: clamped piecewise-V responses with finitely many sources equal the Green superposition with coefficients the third-derivative jumps.

equations_and_steps.label: eq:green-system
equations_and_steps.scope: Specialized: the double-zero system at l for the Green coefficients, in the basis (sin x - x cos x, x sin x).

equations_and_steps.label: eq:green-construction
equations_and_steps.scope: Exact up to basis: the Green function is the truncated jumper plus the element of V fixed by the linear system.

equations_and_steps.label: eq:net-weight-plain
equations_and_steps.scope: Related: the plain net mass on a line appears as the jump weight of the sine load; S_plus/minus are not formalized separately.

equations_and_steps.label: eq:sine-load-jump
equations_and_steps.scope: Related: the one-atom Duhamel formula for |sin|, whose slope term 2 sin(y - knot) carries the jump of the sine load at an atom.

equations_and_steps.label: eq:angular-kernel
equations_and_steps.scope: Specialized: the explicit centered kernel (pi/2 - tau) cos tau + sin tau on [0, pi]; the other cases follow by evenness and periodicity.
